## Checklist

- [ ] Generic: a team with a different product and stack would benefit from it (MAINTAINING.md, section 3).
- [ ] No private data: no company, product, person or customer names, no internal paths.
- [ ] Docs consistent: `docs/GUIDE.md` updated if a command changed, `README.md` if the cycle changed.
- [ ] Visuals re-rendered from `docs/images/src/` if the cycle changed.
- [ ] A line under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
